newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-TVL WON TOSS AND BAT AGAINST GRIQUAS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TVL WON TOSS AND BAT AGAINST GRIQUAS.

text.p: Transvaal skipper Ken Rutherford won the toss and opted to bat on the opening day of his side's four-day Supersport Series match against Griqualand West in Kimberley on Friday.
Griqualand West - Mickey Arthur (captain), Martyn Gidley, Finley Brooker, Pieter Barnard, Craig Light, Ralph Koster, Cedric English, Wendell Bossenger, Brett Benkenstein, Garth Roe, Vaughn Walsh.
Transvaal - Adam Bacher, Mark Benfield, Neil McKenzie, Ken Rutherford (captain), Dean Laing, Nic Pothas, Ross Veenstra, Stefan Jacobs, Clive Eksteen, Trevor Webster, Wayne Kidwell.
